_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all fares on svcabs.net. Edit this file, then run `node tools/build-fares.mjs` and commit the regenerated HTML alongside it. Never hand-edit HTML between the FARES:START/END markers.

whatsapp.consumerPrefill: Hi! I would like a fare for the {vehicle} in Chennai.
whatsapp.corporatePrefill: Hi, I'd like a corporate transport proposal for my company.

source: Indicative starting rates. Final fare confirmed on WhatsApp.

pdf._note: Exported by hand, so it can drift from the rates above — and a PDF that contradicts the page is worse than no PDF. `ratesHash` fingerprints the vehicles, quote-only cards and terms as of the last export: build-fares.mjs warns on every run while it disagrees with the current data, and fails outright if the file is missing. After re-exporting, run `node tools/build-fares.mjs --stamp-pdf` to record the new fingerprint and date.
pdf.headline: Take the full tariff with you
pdf.blurb: Both rate tables and the fare terms, on two pages.
pdf.label: Download PDF

terms: Rates cover fuel and the driver's service for local use.
Tolls, parking, permits and state-entry charges are billed as actuals.
Driver batta is charged per calendar day (outstation).
Beyond the package, extra km and hours are charged at the rates shown.
Outstation trips are subject to the minimum km/day shown.
No advance payment. No surge pricing.
Rates may be revised if fuel prices move; a confirmed quote is honoured.
_groupsNote: Minimum km/day is per vehicle (outstation.minKm), not per group — the Hycross runs 300 km/day while the rest of the cars run 250.
